question: 'A Champion's Mind: Lessons from a Life in Tennis' is the autobiography of which of the following tennis player?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Pete Sampras.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'A Champion's Mind: Lessons from a Life in Tennis' is the autobiography of **Pete Sampras. **
 
• A man whose hard-nosed work ethic led to an unprecedented number one world ranking for 286 weeks and whose prodigious talent made possible a record-setting fourteen Grand Slam titles.
 
• Pete Sampras holds the distinction of being the** youngest male player** to win the** U.S. Open. **
 
• During his career, he won **sixty-four top-level singles titles **(including fourteen Grand Slams, eleven ATP Masters Series titles, and five Tennis Masters Cup titles).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
